scientific_integrity: All dimensional statements are supported by an analytic proof. Supplementary finite numerical checks do not substitute for proof. The two-by-two result is prior work and not claimed novel; an unlocated equivalent historical optimization remains possible.
scientific_limitations: The exact maximum is over rank-one-positive, flat-negative boundary-limit derivatives of the real symmetric Frobenius PSD projector; no exact unrestricted maximum-entry Lipschitz coefficient is claimed. The global coefficient is proved to have linear growth, with an explicit lower bound and an upper bound n.
title: Sharp rank-one-boundary diagonal sensitivity and dimension-linear instability of semidefinite projection
